**Directions: Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence. **

The doctor said to my mother, “Take your medicines regularly.”

options.text: The doctor advised my mother to take her medicines regularly.
The doctor told my mother take her medicines regularly.
The doctor ordered my mother to take your medicines regularly.
The doctor told my mother to take his medicines regularly.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **The doctor advised my mother to take her medicines regularly**.

__
 
• The given sentence is a direct speech.
 
• The basic rules for changing or ____converting direct speech into indirect speech__:​
 __
 
• The commas and inverted commas are removed.
 
• The verb 'advised' is used in place of "**said to**".
 
• When we want **to convey advice, offer, order or promise in the reported speech** we use the **verbs** **advice, offer, order or promise** followed by the **to-infinitive **(**here, to take**).
 
• When we transfer an **advice sentence** we use: **...advise + to + infinitive verb + ….**
 
 

Hence, the correct option is option 1.
